bank.q: int s=0; for(i=1;i<=3;i++) s+=i; s is?
Which skips only the current iteration?
A while loop whose condition is false at the start runs?
Nested loops 5 x 2 run the inner body?

bank.model: while tests the condition before each iteration (may run zero times); do-while tests after (always runs at least once) and ends with a semicolon.

bank.q: What is an infinite loop and what usually causes it?
bank.model: A loop that never ends because the condition never becomes false, usually from forgetting to update the control variable.

bank.title: Mini project: Times table and stars
bank.brief: Read a number n and print its times table 1 to 12. Then print a pyramid of stars with n rows.
